01 · The list

Greetings and phrases,
level by level

Greetings and set phrases in Chinese: hello and goodbye, thank you and sorry, please, yes and no, and the social phrases that make a first conversation work, from the HSK vocabulary lists with readings and meanings.

In Lock&Learn Chinese these words sit in their level packs (HSK 1, HSK 2, HSK 6), one per glance on the widget: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 1 is free; every other pack opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily.

Type to filter by hanzi, pinyin or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

HanziPinyinMeaningLevelExample
不客气bú kèqiyou are welcomeHSK 1甲：谢谢。乙：不客气。Jiǎ: Xièxie. Yǐ: Bú kèqi.Thank you. You're welcome.
对不起duìbuqǐi am sorryHSK 1对不起，我不是故意的。Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bú shì gùyì de.I am sorry, I did not do it on purpose.
没关系méi guān xiit does not matterHSK 1对不起，没关系。Duì bù qǐ, méi guān xi.I am sorry. It does not matter.
请qǐngpleaseHSK 1请进。Qǐng jìn.Please come in.
喂wéihello on phoneHSK 1喂，你现在在家吗？Wéi, nǐ xiànzài zài jiā ma?Hello, are you at home right now?
谢谢xièxieto thankHSK 1谢谢你的苹果。Xièxie nǐ de píngguǒ.Thank you for the apple.
再见zàijiàngoodbyeHSK 1老师，再见。Lǎoshī, zàijiàn.Goodbye, teacher.
欢迎huānyíngto welcomeHSK 2

03 · Questions

Asked and
answered

What are the basic greetings in Chinese?

The 9 greetings and phrases below come from the HSK vocabulary lists with their readings and meanings. The beginner-level ones come with a real sentence.

Which HSK levels are these words from?

7 from HSK 1, 1 from HSK 2, 1 from HSK 6. The level chip on each row says where the word sits, so you can stop at your level or read ahead. Beginner-level words carry a real example sentence; the rest show word, pinyin and meaning, with their sentences in the app.

How do I learn greetings and phrases words on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. Enable the level packs these words come from (HSK 1, HSK 2, HSK 6). A word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
